conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: My PPI wallet isn’t linking to my new debit card! What’s the problem?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the issue, sir. Can you confirm the last four digits of your card?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s two three four five. I’ve tried like ten times already!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It seems the card isn’t registered for PPI. I’ll enable it now. Please try again in 10 minutes.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Ten minutes? Can’t you do it faster? I need to pay a bill!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’ve expedited it, sir. It’s active now, and you should be able to link it immediately.
